selection_rule: Highest mean of per-world primary-target official MIA scores; ties within 1e-12 choose smaller strength. Worlds receive equal weight.
holdout_rule: Run only the fixed selected strength and masked strength-zero baseline. No reselection.
privacy: Save aggregate counts and metrics only. Keep individual source positions, labels and predictions in memory.
limitations: Candidate membership is globally exclusive, but noncandidate source donors recur across targets because A_bg is small.
Public rare detection is a proxy, not true is_rare.
Existing person partitions were used in prior v1 work; new world seeds are not fully untouched people.
The source is A_bg and the independent reference is B; their actual contest roles are reversed.
